title: 06 Days | 05 Nights Excursions from Kandy, Sigiriya & Colombo
description: Explore Sri Lanka's vibrant culture and breathtaking landscapes with our 06 days / 05 nights tour package. This journey takes you through iconic destinations like Sigiriya, Kandy, and Colombo. Discover ancient ruins, lush tea plantations, and bustling city markets while enjoying comfortable accommodations and expert guidance throughout your Sri Lankan adventure.

itinerary.title: Airport - Pinnawala - Kandy
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed. Your journey begins with a visit to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where you can watch elephants bathe in the river. Afterward, proceed to Kandy for a city tour, including a visit to the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic. Enjoy an evening cultural dance performance.

itinerary.title: Kandy - Peradeniya - Nuwara Eliya - Kandy
itinerary.description: Start your day with a visit to the Royal Botanical Gardens in Peradeniya. Then, embark on a scenic drive to Nuwara Eliya, often called 'Little England.' On the way, visit a tea plantation and factory to learn about Ceylon tea. Take a stroll through Nuwara Eliya city and enjoy the cool climate before returning to Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy - Dambulla - Minneriya - Sigiriya
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Dambulla to explore the ancient Golden Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage site known for its stunning cave paintings and statues. In the afternoon, enjoy an exciting wildlife safari at Minneriya National Park, famous for its large elephant herds. Finally, proceed to Sigiriya for your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya - Colombo
itinerary.description: Climb the majestic Sigiriya Rock Fortress, another UNESCO site, and admire the breathtaking views from the summit. Afterward, travel to Colombo. Explore the city's key landmarks, including Independence Square, Gangaramaya Temple, and the vibrant local markets. Enjoy a relaxing evening in the bustling commercial capital.

itinerary.title: Colombo - Bentota - Galle - Colombo
itinerary.description: Head south to Bentota for some relaxation on the sandy beaches. Enjoy a boat ride on the Madu River and visit a turtle hatchery. Continue your journey to Galle to explore the historic Galle Fort, a beautifully preserved colonial landmark. Return to Colombo for your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Colombo - City Tour - Airport - Colombo
itinerary.description: Embark on a comprehensive Colombo city tour, visiting popular spots like the National Museum and Gale Face Green. Spend some time shopping for souvenirs at local malls. Finally, you will be transferred to the airport for your departure, taking home wonderful memories of your Sri Lankan tour.

description: Embark on a spiritual journey following the legendary Ramayana trail through Sri Lanka. This 10-day tour takes you to the most significant sites associated with the epic, from the ancient ruins of Anuradhapura to the misty mountains of Nuwara Eliya and the coastal temples. Experience the rich history and deep spirituality of these sacred locations while enjoying the natural beauty of the island.

title: Colombo & Negombo To Galle | Hikkaduwa | Mirissa Day Tour
description: Below are the locations for your day trip across the South Coast of Sri Lanka, a journey known for its beautiful beaches and vibrant coastal culture. The itinerary begins with a visit to Galle Fort, a historic fortified city that reflects Sri Lanka's cultural heritage. The session features activities such as visiting the Galle Fort Lighthouse and exploring the old Dutch Hospital, providing panoramic views that are perfect for photography. Following this, the tour continues to the Kosgoda Sea Turtle Conservation Project, where participants can learn about and witness the conservation efforts for sea turtles. Here, the team cares for the eggs and young turtles for up to five years before releasing them back into the wild. Afterward, lunch is served at a highly-rated beachside restaurant on Unawatuna Beach, where visitors can also enjoy a relaxing walk along the coast. Following lunch, the tour heads back to Galle Fort to visit the iconic lighthouse and take more photographs. Another unique experience is offered at Koggala, where guests can try stilt fishing, a traditional method of fishing in Sri Lanka. The journey then proceeds to the Japanese Peace Pagoda in Rumassala, and concludes with a brief stop at the Sea Turtle Farm in Galle Mahamodara, further highlighting the region's efforts in sea turtle conservation.

Experience the thrill of standing before the roaring waters and feel the mist on your face as you take in the awe-inspiring beauty of nature. Whether you're a nature lover, adventure seeker, or simply looking for a serene escape, our Diyaluma Waterfall tour promises an enriching and memorable experience in the heart of Sri Lanka's wilderness. Book your adventure today and create lasting memories amidst the stunning beauty of Diyaluma.

title: Udawalawe National Park Wildlife Safari from Galle
description: Below are the locations for your day trip. 1. Udawalawe National Park. Your day will begin with pick-up at Galle. Then, relax on the 1 and half hour drive to Udawalawe National Park, created in the 1970s to provide a sanctuary for wild animals displaced by the construction of the Udawalawe Reservoir on the Walawe River. Udawalawe National Park is a renowned wildlife sanctuary known for its diverse and abundant wildlife, with a special focus on its large elephant population, Now the third most visited park in Sri Lanka. The park's picturesque landscapes encompass lush grasslands, forests, and a scenic reservoir Here, you'll embark on a thrilling jeep safari. Visitors can embark on thrilling jeep safaris led by expert guides to observe elephants, leopards, birds, and other fascinating creatures in their natural habitat. Udawalawe National Park is not only a wildlife haven but also a place of conservation and environmental significance, making it a must-visit destination for nature enthusiasts and wildlife lovers.

title: From Ella: All-Inclusive Day Trip to 5 Landmarks
description: Below are the locations for your day trip. 1. Ella Rock. 2. Demodara Railway Loop Viewpoint. 3. Nine Arch Bridge. 4. Ravana Falls. 5. Little Adam's Peak. 6. Flying Ravana Mega Zipline. title: From Ella: Lipton Seat & Dambatenne Tea Factory Day Tour
description: Below are the locations for your day trip. 1. Dambethenna Tea Factory. 2. Lipton's Seat. Explore the Dambatenne countryside, head past green fields and tea plantations for the chance to see traditional life in the area. Start your tour as you head to Dambatenne Tea Factory, built in 1890 by Sir Thomas Lipton, one of the most famous figures in tea history. Take a tour through the works for an education on the processes involved in the fermentation, rolling, drying, cutting, sieving and grading of tea. Enjoy one of the most comprehensive tea factory tours around, and afterwards, take the chance to try a cup. Move on to Lipton’s Seat Lookout, one of Sri Lanka's most impressive viewpoints. Here, Sir Thomas Lipton used to survey his burgeoning empire, and today it's said you can see across emerald hills and tea estates to no fewer than seven different provinces.

description: Below are the locations for your day trip. 1. Sacred Bodhi Tree. 2. Ruwanwelisaya Stupa. 3. The Royal Palace and Abhayagiri Monastery. 4. Isurumuniya Vihara. 5. Twin Ponds. 6. Moonstone. 7. Wessagiriya. Explore the ancient city of Anuradhapura, a UNESCO World Heritage site and the first capital of Sri Lanka. Experience the profound spirituality of the Sacred Bodhi Tree, admire the grand Ruwanwelisaya Stupa, and explore the intricate ruins of royal palaces and monasteries. Your guided tour includes visits to several significant historic and religious sites in This ancient city.

title: Fom Dambulla: Sigiriya Rock & Ancient City of Polonnaruwa
description: Below are the locations for your day trip. 1. Royal Palace. 2. Nissankamulla Palace. 3. Gal Viharaya. 4. Thuparama stupa. 5. Lankathilaka stupa. 6. Vatadage. 7. Rankoth Vehera. 8. Parakramabahu Statue. 9. Sigiriya Rock Fortress. Experience the magnificent history of Sri Lanka with a full-day tour from Dambulla to Sigiriya and Polonnaruwa. Explore the remains of the Royal Palace, visit ancient stupas like Thuparama and Lankathilaka, and marvel at the colossal rock carvings at Gal Vihara. The tour concludes with a visit to the iconic Sigiriya Rock Fortress, providing a comprehensive look at the island's archaeological wealth.

title: From Sigiriya : Polonnaruwa Ancient City Tour | Day Tour
description: Below are the locations for your day trip. 1. Gal Vihara. 2. Royal Palace Complex. 3. Parakrama Samudra. 4. Polonnaruwa Vatadage. 5. Lotus Pond. Discover the medieval capital of Sri Lanka, Polonnaruwa, on a full-day tour from Sigiriya. Explore the well-preserved ruins of the Royal Palace and the stunning Buddha statues at Gal Vihara. Visit the massive Parakrama Samudra reservoir and the intricately designed Vatadage. A deep dive into the history and architecture of This UNESCO World Heritage site.

title: Polonnaruwa Ancient City Tour with Minneriya Elephant Safari
description: Below are the locations for your day trip. 1. Royal Palace Complex. 2. Gal Vihara. 3. sacred Quadrangle. 4. Minneriya National Park. Begin your adventure in Polonnaruwa, a UNESCO World Heritage Site celebrated for its rich history and archaeological marvels. Roam among ancient ruins, stone sculptures, and monuments. Our experienced guides will lead you through the Royal Palace and the awe-inspiring Gal Vihara. After exploring the ancient city, embark on a thrilling safari at Minneriya National Park to observe magnificent elephant herds in their natural habitat.

title: Galle and Bentota Day-Tour From Colombo
description: After being picked up at your hotel, hop onboard your Madu Ganga Magrove boat safari and explore the Madu River. See the mangrove forests and marshlands that surround the river. Stop at a cinnamon garden, and try some of the area’s famous cinnamon. The Madu Ganga River region is home to some of the best quality cinnamon in the world as well as a flourishing cinnamon industry. Afterward, marvel at the fishermen who stoically sit atop large branches planted in the middle of the water waiting for their catch. Continue to a local Turtle Hatchery, where your guide will introduce you to the many local varieties of turtles. End your tour with a visit to the Galle Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This fort illustrates the unique interaction of European architecture and South Asian traditions from the 16th to the 19th centuries. After discovering the fort, you will be returned to your hotel in Colombo

title: From Colombo : Day Trip to Kandy | Pinnwala | Royal Gardens
description: Experience the vibrant culture and natural beauty of Sri Lanka on this captivating tour from Colombo to Kandy. Your journey begins with a visit to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where you can observe and interact with orphaned elephants as they bathe and play in the river. This heartwarming experience offers a glimpse into the conservation efforts dedicated to protecting these magnificent creatures. Continue to the Temple of the Tooth in Kandy, a sacred Buddhist site that houses the relic of the tooth of the Buddha. Marvel at the intricate architecture and experience the spiritual atmosphere of this revered temple. Next, immerse yourself in the tranquility of the Royal Botanical Gardens in Peradeniya. Explore the vast collection of plants, including orchids, palms, and medicinal plants, while enjoying the peaceful ambiance of this botanical paradise. Afterwards, embark on a spice walk in Kandy, where you'll learn about the spices that are integral to Sri Lankan cuisine. Engage your senses as you smell and taste a variety of spices, gaining insight into their flavors and uses. Conclude your tour with a visit to a tea factory, where you'll learn about the process of tea production from leaf to cup. Discover the art of tea making and sample some of the finest Ceylon tea. Finally, make your way to Kandy View Point, where you'll be rewarded with panoramic views of the city and its picturesque surroundings. Capture the breathtaking scenery and create lasting memories of your journey through Sri Lanka. The tour will conclude with drop-off at the same location in Colombo where you were picked up.
inclusions: Complimentary pickup and drop-off ( Colombo, Dehiwala, Kadawatha, Gampaha, Kandy )

title: From Colombo : Sigiriya and Dambulla Day Trip and Safari
description: Depart Colombo and travel by a shared vehicle, in a small group, to the city of Sigiriya, and head directly to Sigiriya Rock on arrival. Gaze in awe at the massive column of rock that, according to the ancient Sri Lankan chronicle The Culavamsa, was selected by King Kassyapa as the site of his new capital. Admire numerous paintings of historic queens, princesses, and maids inside the rock fortress before getting a break for lunch at your own expense. Then, explore some of the traditional crafts of the region, such as wood carving and batik textiles, with time to purchase souvenirs before departing. Start the journey back towards Colombo via Dambulla to explore the largest and best-preserved cave temple complex in Sri Lanka. Discover the magnificent Buddha images and rock paintings of vivid colors and different shapes, painted from around the 2nd century B.C. up to the 18th-century Kandyan era Optionally Can be done the Wild Life Safari at Eco Park or Kaudulla National Park or Minneriya National park charges for National Park very on Pax Count ( For solo Passengers $ 100 & $ 60 )

title: From Colombo : Galle and Bentota Day Tour
description: Your journey starts with a morning pickup from your hotel in Colombo, then you'll head south to the charming town of Bentota. Upon arrival at the Madu River, you'll embark on a breathtaking boat safari, navigating through winding mangroves and peaceful waterways. Discover the diverse ecosystem and wildlife that call this river home. Next, visit the Kosgoda Sea Turtle Conservation Project, where you'll learn about the efforts to protect and release sea turtles into the ocean. Get a chance to see different species of sea turtles and their hatchlings up close. The adventure continues to the historic Galle Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Stroll through the cobblestone streets, admire the colonial architecture, and take in the stunning views of the Indian Ocean from the fort walls. Visit the Dutch Reformed Church, the Galle Lighthouse, and explore the charming shops and galleries within the fort. After a day of exploration, you'll be dropped back at your hotel in Colombo, feeling enriched by the beauty and history of Sri Lanka's coastal gems. The tour concludes with a visit to the UNESCO-listed Galle Fort, a remarkable blend of European and South Asian architecture spanning centuries. After this unforgettable journey, you'll be safely returned to your Colombo hotel. Don't miss this opportunity to immerse yourself in nature, culture, and history.
inclusions: Hotel pickup and drop-off in Colombo, Dehiwala, Mount Lavinia, Kalutara,Bentota, Beruwala, Kosgoda, Ahungalla, and Balapitiya area

title: From Colombo | Negambo : Sigiriya, Dambulla and Minneriya Day Trip
description: Explore the Sigiriya Lion Rock Fortress and Minneriya National Park on a day trip from Colombo. Visit the Hiriwadunna Village and enjoy a Sri Lankan buffet, take a jeep safari in Minneriya National Park, and visit the Dambulla Cave Temple. Start your day with a visit to the Sigiriya Lion Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the 8th Wonder of the World. Climb to the top of the rock and admire the panoramic views of the surrounding area. Next, visit the Hiriwadunna Village and enjoy a Sri Lankan buffet. Take a village safari, starting with a bull cart ride, then go to the lake for a catamaran ride, and finally go to a village home. Enjoy a Sri Lankan rice and curry meal with a small cookery demonstration. Afterwards, experience a 3-hour jeep safari in Minneriya National Park. Minneriya National Park is known for its large population of elephants, and you can see them gathering around the tank during the dry season. Finally, visit the Dambulla Cave Temple, another UNESCO World Heritage Site. Admire the beautiful cave paintings and statues of Buddha. End your day with a drop-off at your hotel in Colombo or Negombo.
exclusions: Entry ticket to all places and activities

title: Colombo: Galle and Bentota Day Trip From Colombo City
description: Explore the scenic beauty of Sri Lanka's southern coast on this full-day trip from Colombo. Visit the historic Galle Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and enjoy the stunning views of the Indian Ocean. Discover the charming town of Bentota and its pristine beaches. Take a boat safari along the Madu River, exploring the mangroves and local wildlife. Visit a turtle hatchery and learn about the conservation efforts to protect these majestic creatures. Enjoy a delicious lunch at a local restaurant. This private tour offers a personalized experience with a knowledgeable guide. Your day begins with a pickup from your hotel in Colombo. Relax in a comfortable vehicle as you travel to the southern coast. First, visit the Kosgoda Sea Turtle Conservation Project, where you can see different species of sea turtles and learn about their life cycle. Next, head to the Madu River for a boat safari. Navigate through the mangroves and see the diverse flora and fauna of the area. Continue to the historic Galle Fort, where you can walk along the fort walls and admire the colonial architecture. Explore the narrow streets and visit the lighthouse, the Dutch Reformed Church, and the Maritime Museum. After a day of exploration, you will be dropped back at your hotel in Colombo.
inclusions: Pickup and drop-off from Colombo, Dehiwala, Mount Lavinia, and Negombo Hotels
exclusions: Madu River boat safari ($30 for solo travelers, $25 per person if 2 or more travelers)

title: Colombo Full day city tour
description: Explore the highlights of Colombo on a full-day city tour. Visit the Gangaramaya Temple, the Independence Memorial Hall, and the National Museum. Admire the colonial architecture of the Colombo Fort area and the vibrant colors of the Pettah market. Enjoy a walk along the Galle Face Green and see the sunset over the Indian Ocean. This tour offers a comprehensive overview of the city's history, culture, and modern life. Your day begins with a pickup from your hotel in Colombo. First, visit the Gangaramaya Temple, one of the most important Buddhist temples in the city. Admire its eclectic architecture and the collection of artifacts in its museum. Next, head to the Independence Memorial Hall, built to commemorate Sri Lanka's independence from British rule. Explore the beautiful gardens and the memorial museum. Continue to the National Museum of Colombo, the largest museum in the country, and learn about the island's rich heritage. Afterwards, drive through the Colombo Fort area, where you can see historical buildings such as the Old Parliament and the Dutch Hospital. Explore the bustling streets of Pettah, known for its colorful markets and bazaar. Finally, head to the Galle Face Green, a popular urban park, and enjoy the sea breeze. After a day of discovery, you will be dropped back at your hotel in Colombo.
inclusions: Complimentary pickup and drop-off ( Colombo, Dehiwala, Mount Laviniya )
